logs.description: Array of log message strings. Preserved for backwards compatibility.

entries.description: Structured log entries with timestamp and severity metadata. Only present on the cursor-based path.

lastCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page of results. Present when more log entries exist older than the last entry in this response. Absent when there are no further results.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the log entry (RFC3339 format)

severity.description: PostgreSQL severity level (e.g. LOG, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL)
